subject: Your 68-day insider pass is ready
preview_text: A thank you for sticking with us. Here's something only long-term users get.
body_paragraphs: 68 days ago you downloaded Predictify. Most people quit after a week. You didn't. That tells me you're serious about racing—and you deserve something for it.

I want to thank you personally. Not with a generic coupon or a discount code. With something only a handful of users will ever see: insider access to our daily racecard briefings. These are the notes our AI team writes for Premium subscribers—the same analysis that turns a 12-1 outsider into a 59% confidence call.

Open the app, tap the 'Insider' tab. You'll see a live briefing for today's biggest meet—form angles, track biases, and the one horse the AI is watching that the oddsmakers haven't caught yet. It's updated every 2AM, so you get it before the market moves.
Tap the 'Insider' tab now and see what the AI sees. P.S. This access expires in 48 hours—after that, it's locked behind the Premium wall. Don't let it slip.
